name: Treebeard
subtitle: Keeper of the Watchwood
game_text:
To play, spot 3 <culture>Gandalf</culture> companions.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert Treebeard twice to play a <culture>Gandalf</culture> condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.
flavor_text: “‘Leave it to the Ents!... Trees are coming back to live here, old trees, wild trees.’”
